directiveOperand.citation: ISO §2023:7.3.23.2 general format: REF-MOD-ZERO-LENGTH and OFF are underlined, ON is not, so per §2023:5.2.3 the ON alternative may be selected with the word omitted; §2023:7.3.23.3 GR1 governs the omitted DIRECTIVE.

description: The >>REF-MOD-ZERO-LENGTH {ON|OFF} compiler directive (ISO §2023:7.3.23) — a COBOL-2023 addition (Annex E.3.3 item 23): when ON, a reference modification MAY have a zero-length result (§2023:8.4.3.3.4 item 5c); when OFF/omitted (the default) a zero-length ref-mod raises EC-BOUND-REF-MOD (§2023:7.3.23.3 GR1). A text-manipulation-stage directive consumed by RefModZeroLengthDirectiveProcessor and folded per source line; the introduction gate rejects the directive below 2023.
source:
>>REF-MOD-ZERO-LENGTH ON
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. RMZL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 W PIC X(5) VALUE "HELLO".
       01 R PIC X(5).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           MOVE W (3:0) TO R.
           DISPLAY R.
           STOP RUN.
